lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Tell us did you carry her out there or did you use somethin' to get her back there?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well, we lifted her out of the jeep and put her on like a, like a wheeled thing.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like the things where you get under the car.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And is that creeper always kept in his garage?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well he was borrowing it from the yard or somethin' like that.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What's that creeper say on it? Do you remember? (Brendan shakes head "no") What color is it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Black and red, OK. So you guys lift her out of the truck,

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And you got which part of her again?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And you put her on the creeper?
